Ava (Design): Quick heads-up — I'm posting a short proposal for consolidating the left nav groups, switching to path-first routing for shareable deep links, and a few breadcrumb behaviors to review. TL;DR: group by workflow (Models, Serving, Monitoring) instead of infra, make routes canonical so links are copyable. PTAL in the next 24h, aim to ship to staging next week. :sparkles:

Priya (Product): Love the workflow-first approach. one question: will nested items auto-expand when you hit a deep link? also mobile considerations? we need API Keys surfaced for SRE without extra clicks.

Sam (Eng): Quick tech note: moving to path-first routing (no client-side hash) makes server-side redirects simpler and plays nicer with crawlers. We should add middleware to 301 legacy hash links to the new path. Proposed canonical mappings: `/app/models/:id` -> models overview, `/app/deploy/:id` -> deployment page. Example lightweight client fallback for older bookmarks:
```
if (location.hash.startsWith('#/')) {
  const p = location.hash.slice(1);
  history.replaceState(null, '', '/app' + p);
}
```
This keeps UX smooth while we add server-side redirects.

Ethan (Eng-Platform): Heads up — some customers' SAML/SSO relay state uses fragments. If we change fragment semantics we must validate IdP flows. Add SAML test cases to the rollout plan.

Ava (Design): Good catch, Ethan. I'll add SAML + IdP tests to the PR checklist. Accessibility nits: keyboard focus should land on the breadcrumb after a programmatic route change, and left nav items must expose `aria-current="page"`. Suggested markup: `role="navigation" aria-label="App sidebar"` and active item gets `aria-current="page" tabindex=0`.

Maria (DesignOps): Quick copy nit — product has been preferring the label "Serving" over "Deployments" in enterprise docs. Can we make the top-level labels configurable per org (org settings) so customers can choose their terminology?

Jon (UX Research): :eyes: Can we add analytics? Instrument `nav_click` with origin (sidebar|breadcrumb|topbar) and `deep_link_open` for copy/paste share counts. Also capture whether deep link came from external referrer. That will help validate discoverability.

Priya (Product): Agree on events. Also deep links into build logs get very long — maybe add a redirector route `/r/:shortId` that expands to the full path so links are friendlier in chat/email.

Sam (Eng): Implementation sketch: 1) server redirector for legacy hashes -> canonical paths, 2) client router migration behind feature flag `new_nav_v2`, 3) aria attributes + focus management, 4) analytics hooks. Staging tests: routing correctness, breadcrumb state, keyboard navigation, SAML IdP flows, analytics. Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error rate + UX regression signals.

Ava (Design): Thanks — I'll update the Figma screens and PR description with the accessibility bits and the feature-flag rollout plan. Can we sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to hand off to eng? @Sam @Ethan please join. :calendar:

Sam (Eng): I'll be there.

Ethan (Eng-Platform): Yep, adding to my calendar.

Design-bot: Ava updated the Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/Nav-Proposal (version 3).
